blocks.text: 重磅IPO前夕，Anthropic重新陷入经营亏损。据彭博社报道，该公司季度营收接近170亿美元，是一年前同期的十二倍。但据The Information报道，175亿美元的运营成本超过了营收，抹去了Anthropic上一季度报告的利润。本季度净亏损达233亿美元，高于去年同期的121亿美元。

blocks.text: Anthropic指出，成本激增主要有两个原因：一是锁定短期算力容量花费50亿美元，二是员工配捐支出20亿美元。自去年年底以来，公司一直面临算力紧张。据《纽约时报》报道，此后它已与亚马逊、谷歌、SpaceX、芯片制造商以及前加密货币矿企签署了数十项协议。预计Anthropic今年将获得超过3.5吉瓦的电力，并计划明年将这一数字翻倍。

blocks.text: Anthropic swings back to an operating loss ahead of its blockbuster IPO. According to Bloomberg, the company posted quarterly revenue of nearly $17 billion, twelve times what it brought in a year earlier. But operating costs of $17.5 billion outpaced that revenue, wiping out the profit Anthropic had reported the previous quarter, according to The Information. The net loss came in at $23.3 billion for the quarter, up from $12.1 billion a year ago.

, twelve times what it brought in a year earlier. But operating costs of $17.5 billion outpaced that revenue, wiping out the profit Anthropic had reported the previous quarter, according to
The Information
. The net loss came in at $23.3 billion for the quarter, up from $12.1 billion a year ago.

blocks.text: Anthropic pointed to two main drivers behind the cost spike: $5 billion for short-term compute capacity it locked in and $2 billion in employee donation matching. The company has been grappling with a compute crunch since late last year. According to the New York Times, it has since signed dozens of deals with Amazon, Google, SpaceX, chipmakers, and former crypto miners. Anthropic is expected to have access to more than 3.5 gigawatts of power this year and plans to double that next year.

blocks.text: All told, the company's updated prospectus shows $895 billion in commitments for compute and data center leases. Those costs add pressure on the IPO, which could raise around $100 billion, the New York Times reports. Up to $3.5 billion of that is expected to come from Japanese investors.
